## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run, target OS/architecture, and relevant limitations.

## Documentation impact

- [ ] Updated the affected guides and `docs/progress.md` in this change.
- [ ] Reconciled current-status claims with implementation and actual test evidence, including known gaps.
- [ ] Added/superseded an ADR if a durable design decision changed.
- [ ] Regenerated `docs/reference.md` if commands/defaults/public choices changed.
- [ ] Refreshed and visually checked screenshots if visible UI changed.
- [ ] Ran `npm run docs:check` and a meaningful base comparison after staging new files; recorded the base used.
- [ ] Included handoff details: source/build status, unverified areas, and remaining work (or explicitly none).

Name any item that does not apply and explain why. A checked box does not replace reading the affected documentation.

Use `docs/handoff.md` for the handoff procedure. Documentation remains part of delivery even for direct commits without a PR; GitHub has no CI/CD requirement.
